# Python-Markdown Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to the
[Python Version Specification](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/version-specifiers/).
See the [Contributing Guide](contributing.md) for details.

## [Unreleased]

### Fixed

* Support automatic links with URL schemes other than HTTP and FTP, such as
  `<ssh://example.org>` (#1244).
* Fix quadratic-time id generation in the `toc` extension when many headers
  share the same text.
* Ignore glossary abbreviations with empty definitions after inline elements,
  consistently with abbreviations before inline elements.
* Strip complete HTML tags with quoted `>` characters from `toc` labels and
  generated heading IDs.
* Fix quadratic-time regex backtracking in `attr_list` when a block ends with an
  unclosed attribute list followed by a long run of spaces, e.g. a line
  consisting only of `{` and some text with many trailing spaces (#1656).
* Fix quadratic-time regex backtracking in hash headers when a long run of `#`

# External Links Extension for Python-Markdown
# ============================================

# Open external links in a new browsing context.

# License: [BSD](https://opensource.org/licenses/bsd-license.php)

"""
Add `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` to external links.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from . import Extension
from ..treeprocessors import Treeprocessor


class ExternalLinksTreeprocessor(Treeprocessor):
    """ Mark every `<a>` element whose `href` starts with `http://` or `https://`. """

    def run(self, root):
        for el in root.iter('a'):
            href = el.get('href', '')
            if href.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
                el.set('target', '_blank')
                el.set('rel', 'noopener noreferrer')


class ExternalLinksExtension(Extension):
    """ Add external links extension to Markdown class. """

    def extendMarkdown(self, md):
        """ Register the treeprocessor.

        | Class Instance | Registry | Name | Priority |
        | -------------- | -------- | ---- | :------: |
        | `ExternalLinksTreeprocessor` | [`treeprocessors`][markdown.Markdown.treeprocessors] | `external_links` | `15` |

        """
        # flake8: noqa: E501 25
        md.registerExtension(self)
        md.treeprocessors.register(ExternalLinksTreeprocessor(md), 'external_links', 15)


def makeExtension(**kwargs):  # pragma: no cover
    """ Return an instance of the `ExternalLinksExtension` """
    return ExternalLinksExtension(**kwargs)
EOF

---
title: External Links Extension

# External Links

## Summary

The External Links extension opens links to other websites in a new browsing
context.

## Syntax

A link is external when its `href` starts with `http://` or `https://`. Every
external `<a>` element, including automatic links such as
`<https://example.com>`, gets `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
Relative links, `#anchors` and `mailto:` links, as well as images, are not
changed.

## Usage

```python
import markdown
html = markdown.markdown(text, extensions=['external_links'])
```

The extension has no configuration options.
